The Saint Luke Guild does not deliver products to individuals; therefore cancellations and returns are not applicable.  Also, donor refunds are not generally offered.  Refunds will be considered on a case-by-case basis before money is distributed to the designated project (e.g., if someone accidentally entered the wrong donation amount and contact is made within one business day).  To request a refund, contact us at refunds@saintlukeguild.com.
